Primary challenges facing overseas markets in 2026.
Eroded Purchasing Power: 
Escalating energy costs and conflict-
driven inflation have significantly reduced 
the discretionary income available to 
overseas investors for luxury real estate.
Middle East Conflict & Its Impact on the Global Economy
Global Economic Stagnation: 
The conclusion of the "shipping surge," 
coupled with rising trade barriers, has 
made cross-border property transactions 
both more costly and less frequent.
Currency Headwinds: 
Global market volatility, paired with a 
strengthening Thai Baht (reaching 31.00 
THB/USD), has significantly increased 
entry costs for international buyers, 
creating a formidable barrier to entry.
